prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1124; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Conroe. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine for the moment. Can you walk me through what happened in the lot?

A: I was backing out of a parking space near the store entrance. I checked my mirrors and started slowly, and then I felt a bump on the driver's side. It was another vehicle coming down the aisle that I didn't see until it was already close.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving when the contact occurred?

A: Very slow, maybe walking pace. I'd say a couple of miles an hour.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right after the impact?

A: Not at first. I felt fine enough to get out and look at the damage. By that evening my neck was stiff, and by the next morning I had a sharp pain going into my shoulders and headaches when I turned my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following day and they diagnosed whiplash. I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Do you have any prior neck or back complaints?

A: I had some mild stiffness years ago after a fall, but nothing that required treatment, and I hadn't had any problems in the year before this happened.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm trying to keep working, but I've had to limit how long I sit at my desk.

Q: Thank you for your time today.
